visual: Double pompon daisies in pink, red or white · compact rosettes · spring colour
water: Keep evenly moist; water containers when the surface begins to dry.
prune: Deadhead to prolong flowering; cut back after flowering.
cvs: 'Tasso' – compact pompon flowers · 'Pomponette' – small quilled doubles · Bellissima Series – larger double pompons
resilience: Generally pest-free; rust can occur; established plants tolerate cold conditions well.
uses: Autumn and spring bedding · edging · containers · window boxes
toxicity: Edible petals are used as garnish, but eating large amounts of the plant may cause stomach upset; children and pets should not eat nursery-grown bedding plants.
hardinessNote: Hardy in most places throughout the UK, approximately -15 to -10°C.
foliage: evergreen; compact rosettes of spoon-shaped dark green leaves
